newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-IVERSEN HAT-TRICK GIVES SPURS BREATHING SPACE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-IVERSEN HAT-TRICK GIVES SPURS BREATHING SPACE.

text.p: Norway international Steffen Iversen hit a hat-trick for Tottenham Hotspur, as the London club crushed Sunderland 4-0 in Tuesday's only premier league tie.

The result, only Tottenham's second win in 10 games, moves them up three places to 10th in the league while Sunderland remain six points off the foot of the table just four points clear of the relegation zone.

Iversen, who had scored only three goals in his previous 12 games for the club, struck for the first time after just 60 seconds when he helped Scottish defender Colin Calderwood's free-kick into the net.
Eight minutes later, another free-kick into the penalty area from Calderwood was flicked on by England midfielder Darren Anderton and Iverson finished off.
In the 26th minute the Norwegian, who joined Spurs from Rosenborg in December, turned provider for Danish international Allan Nielson to make it 3-0.
He completed his hat-trick after 62 minutes with a rifling shot from 25 metres.
